reviews.text: I have used Greylyn Wayne for a number of stages for my listings, they have always done a great job but I was especially thrilled with my last experience with their team and wanted to share it with those considering stagers. We initially had a sale fail and they were quick to remove their staging and were incredibly sensitive to my clients and I, who were dealing with an unexpected surprise of numerous repairs. Once they were completed, they were quick to help us re-stage and launch right away. Once re-listed, we received a full price offer less than a week. Their service and stage were both exceptional and I'll absolutely be using them in the future. Thank you Jacqueline and the Greylyn Wayne team!

—The Greylyn Wayne Team

owner_reply.text:
At Greylyn Wayne, we strive to treat our clients and realtors with fairness and integrity, and we require the same level of professionalism in return.

Regarding the damage to your property, we want to clarify a few points:

Contractor Policy: We prefer to hire our own contractors to repair any damage to the homes we stage. This ensures quality control and prevents unnecessary fees from third-party contractors.

Damage Acknowledgment and Approval Process: We agreed to pay for damages as long as we received a bid before the job was complete. This step is crucial for us to avoid unexpected and inflated costs. While we acknowledged the damage, we did not approve the large invoice from a third party before the work was completed.

We are committed to resolving issues in a fair and transparent manner. However, we cannot accept large, unapproved invoices from third-party contractors. Our goal is always to find an equitable solution, but we will not be pressured into making hasty decisions that are not in the best interest of all parties involved.

Their communication was fantastic, staging was absolutely perfect and fit our very traditional, stately home with some beautiful modern touches to add a fun flare. In fact, I loved working with them so much I'm going to use their services to help me procure some furniture pieces for my new home. I would recommend Greylyn Wayne to anyone looking for beautiful, quality home staging with a trustful and reliable group with outstanding communication.

reviews.text:
They did a great job staging!
But they mingled some of our own artwork with the staging then took it. By the time we picked it up - I think it would have been more appropriate for them to drop it by with us - the frame was scratched. I reached out to them to ask them to repair it and they got defensive saying we had left it with them for quite a while (it’s a pandemic and we are parents). I asked that it be pushed up the chain and never heard back.

owner_reply.text: Thank you for your feedback. We handle all of our furniture and artwork with great care and always request that homes be entirely empty to prevent any mix-ups or damage. In this case, we made an exception for you and incorporated your personal artwork into the staging. We regret that there was an issue and did our best to accommodate your schedule when returning the items. We stand by the quality of our work and professionalism of our team.
